verses.verse:
तत्र वर्णाश्च चत्वारः कथ्यन्ते हि मनीषिभिः।
सथाय्यारोद्यवरोही च संचारीति यथा क्रमः।१०२।
verses.text: There, the wise speak of four varṇas (kinds of melodic movement): sthāyī (steady), ārohī (ascending), avarohī (descending) and sañcārī (wandering), in that order.

commentary.text: In this way these same [actions] have been named the four classes (jātis) of varṇa: sthāyī (steady), ārohī (ascending), avarohī (descending) and sañcārī (wandering). But to make alaṅkāras (patterned exercises), we have to look at those elements of the notes on whose basis alaṅkāras can be made as needed. So, on the basis of the qualities described above, examples of alaṅkāras are presented.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
